      {
        "id": "F20",
        "title": "Plugin idempotency keys exceed their limit and omit invocation identity",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:453",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:471",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1453",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-005-AC005",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-020"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "The plugin idempotency key embeds the full requestId plus a fixed 20-character prefix/suffix overhead (1453), but requestId may be 256 and IdempotencyKey only 128 (453, 471). A valid requestId above 108 characters produces an invalid key. It also omits the full submitting session identity and contextFormat, although the payload fingerprint includes them. Define a bounded canonical key over the full invocation identity and test maximum-length and cross-session calls.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F21",
        "title": "A late verification failure can undo successful finalization",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:338",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1045",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1100",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-010",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-012"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "A late verification failure can overwrite successful finalization. FailHvRunCommand accepts null WorkerId and the released stored fence (1045), checks only FencedLease, and writes Failed plus request retry state (1046). Finalize may commit Succeeded/Completed first (1100) without changing that released fence. Unlike finalization, Fail does not re-check OutputClosed/Finalizing and versions in its transaction. A finalizer that read the earlier state can therefore undo completion. Add state/version-conditional failure acceptance and idempotent terminal behavior, with a concurrent success/verification-failure test.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      }
    ],
    "unknownList": [
      {
        "id": "U01",
        "title": "No-force push flags are not proven",
        "location": [
          "git reflog refs/remotes/origin/docs/hv-architecture-amendment-20261016",
          "docs/receipts/hv/hv-r1-hygiene.json"
        ],
        "evidenceAndRequiredChange": "Nine signed effort commits and eight adjacent recorded push transitions are verified linear and fast-forward. A reflog's update-by-push message does not prove which flags were used. The absolute claim that every push used no force flag needs the original push command/output or a server audit. Do not invent that evidence.",
        "classification": "implementer evidence"
      },
      {
        "id": "U02",
        "title": "Real acceptance-test phase ownership is incomplete",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2352",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2354",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2448",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2465",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2470",
          "PLAN-HVPIPELINE-001/phases H0-H6"
        ],
        "evidenceAndRequiredChange": "The catalog has named tests for all 114 FR acceptance criteria, but no complete real-binding AC-to-phase allocation is supplied. In particular, H1 owns live reviewer/plugin qualification while the worker arrives H3 and streams H6; H5 watcher and H6 stream delivery are parallel, with no explicit activation/rollback contract. Component mocks can be correct, but they do not prove that these production acceptance cases can run in the owning phase. Provide the exact phase and prerequisite binding for each criterion and distinguish H1 adapter tests from later server-launched/live-stream cases. This is an evidence/plan edit, not a request to lower or waive a gate.",
        "classification": "implementer plan edit"
      }
    ],
